M3-2s：「谁写 this+0x3328」有答案了 —— 三张位图、上膛点，以及一处说不通的地方。新仪器（dm/host/hle_thread.c，全部只读）：peek32；任务图的三张位图（+0x3320 依赖源 / +0x3324 待派发 / +0x3328 已完成）与两个"在飞作业表"长度；每条任务的 依赖A(+0x18)/依赖B(+0x1c)/标志(+0x58)；任务包装器帧捕获（[x29-8] = 该作业的图、[x29-0x18] = 序号）；每个线程"最近一次 ArbitrateLock"的期望持有人与实际锁字。反汇编结论：置位**只有一处**——任务包装器末尾 main+0x15f0e6c（ldxr/orr/stlxr 置 1<<序号）；"上膛"在 main+0x1636f50（str w9,[x8] 写低 count 位进 +0x3324，紧接 str wzr,[x8,#4] 清完成位图），随后 bl 0x15ee598 派发、bl 0x15ee898 轮询——这一串就是"跑这张图"的入口（游戏侧从 0x856f50 调进来）；派发器要求 +0x3324 的位 i、rec[i]+0x18 ⊆ +0x3328、rec[i]+0x1c ⊆ +0x3320，满足才原子清位并把作业挂进作业池（池对象 = [0x31143d0]）。真机三轮（.work/logs/r1/r2/r3.log）：三张位图**同时为 0**（22 任务那张图，出图 59/62 停住），而主线程栈上就有**活的包装器帧**（渲染码 → 跑图入口 → 轮询 → 泵 0xdf9794 → 包装器 → 派发器 → 解锁）⇒ M3-2r 那句"22 个任务从未被派发"**不成立**；工人 0x1005 确实在该图的某个任务里，等一把锁字为 0x40001001（持有人 0x1001 = 主线程）的锁，0x1004/0x1006/0x1007 的最近一次锁字都是 0（没卡在锁上），主线程自己也没卡在锁上。矛盾留档：①上膛写全 count 位 ②派发器只清被取走的位（依赖不满足的位会留着）③实测待派发=0 且已完成=0——三者不能同时成立，只剩"上膛读到的 count 与轮询用的不是同一个值"或"完成后被清"（+0x3328 另有清零点 main+0x15eef90，属另一条跑图路径 main+0x15ee9d8 的收尾；渲染码里 0x853b38 / 0x856f50 / 0x857270 是相邻的三次跑图调用）。下一步是把三张位图做成时间序列（主线程每次 SVC 采样、变化即打一行），之后是宿主侧锁账本与核"图 == x26+0x2D40"。文档：新增「M3-2s」并给「M3-2r」的定性加更正批注，重写「七、下一步」第 1 条；CROSS_MACHINE §7 同步（含本机新坑：cmd 是 936 代码页而仓库 .cmd 是 UTF-8 无 BOM，直接跑构建脚本会被中文注释拆行，先 chcp 65001 再 call）。

M3-2r：里程碑 B（客体停住）的形状量出来了 —— 主线程在等一个**从未被派发**的任务图。新仪器（都在 dm/host/hle_thread.c，默认不影响行为）：SleepThread 时长/时刻、每线程最近 16 次 svc 环（号+参数+LR）、沿 regs[29]（x29 帧指针链）取落在 main 的调用链（安卓侧第一次能读到"游戏在哪个函数"）、每次等待"已等 X 秒"、锁移交历史（最近 16 次 ArbitrateUnlock）、任务图完成位图（从 [x29-8] 取任务图对象，读 +0x3328 位图与 +0x3100 掩码）。关键读数：位图**恒为 0**、等待掩码 0x16 ⇒ 任务图 22 个任务一个都没完成；同一时刻工人 0x1005 解码 Granny 段（svc #0x83/#0x84 门）后去等一把被主线程持有的锁（已等 15.1 秒，而该锁从未出现在任何一次锁移交里 ⇒ 排除"锁字残留"）；我们图形侧空闲，出图停是结果不是原因。两个假设被实测否掉：DM_GRANNY_PRE=0（关预解码）跑 3 轮照旧全部判死；锁语义开关 DM_LOCK_SEM 的 bit0（ArbitrateUnlock 改 Horizon 的"清零+唤醒一个"）3 轮全部启动早期 svcBreak/Panic、出图 0，bit1（放宽 ArbitrateLock 的阻塞条件）3 轮全部在"阶段 启动"判死、出图 0 ⇒ 现状锁实现与 SDK 自洽，锁不是根因（开关留在代码里、默认关）。另记一条反汇编路子（本机没有 Python）：用 NDK 的 llvm-objcopy 把 main.patched.bin 包成 ELF（--rename-section .data=.text,alloc,load,readonly,code）+ llvm-objdump -d --start-address/--stop-address；main.patched.bin 的文件偏移就等于 main+0x。文档：补上被代码注释引用的「M3-2r」一节，并修掉悬空的「M3-2g」编号（其真实内容是「M3 第 3 步」）。  M3-2r: the shape of milestone B (the guest stall) is measured -- the main thread waits on a task graph that was never dispatched. New instruments (all in dm/host/hle_thread.c, no behaviour change by default): SleepThread duration/time, a per-thread SVC ring of the last 16 calls (number + args + LR), a call chain collected along regs[29] (the x29 frame-pointer chain) keeping the return addresses that land in main (the first time Android can read "which game function"), a "waiting X s" reading per wait, a lock-handoff history (the last 16 ArbitrateUnlocks), and the task-graph completion bitmap (the task-graph object comes from [x29-8]; +0x3328 is the bitmap and +0x3100 this waiter's mask). Key readings: the bitmap is always 0 with wait mask 0x16 => none of the task graph's 22 tasks ever completes; at that moment worker 0x1005, after decoding Granny segments (the svc #0x83/#0x84 gates), waits on a lock held by the main thread (waiting 15.1 s, and that lock never appears in any handoff => a stale lock word is ruled out); our graphics side is idle, so the missing presents are a result rather than a cause. Two hypotheses were killed by measurement: DM_GRANNY_PRE=0 (pre-decode off) still declared dead in all 3 rounds; the DM_LOCK_SEM switch's bit0 (ArbitrateUnlock switched to Horizon's "clear and wake one") ended all 3 rounds in an early-startup svcBreak/panic with 0 presents, and bit1 (loosening ArbitrateLock's blocking condition) was declared dead in the startup stage in all 3 rounds with 0 presents => the current lock implementation is self-consistent with the SDK and the locks are not the root cause (the switch stays in the code, off by default). One more thing recorded: how to disassemble on a machine without Python (wrap main.patched.bin into an ELF with the NDK's llvm-objcopy, --rename-section .data=.text,alloc,load,readonly,code, then llvm-objdump -d --start-address/--stop-address; the file offset in main.patched.bin is exactly main+0x). Docs: the "M3-2r" section referenced by code comments now exists, and the dangling "M3-2g" label is fixed (its real content is "M3 step 3").

M3-2q：「九」第 2 项（零拷贝内存优先 HOST_CACHED）取证并**否掉** —— 探针扩了 DM_FD_MEM_TYPE / DM_FD_FORCE / DM_FD_SIZE 与"普通缓冲 vs 外部缓冲"的类型位对照：类型 6 上分配、取 fd、mmap 到指定地址、双向全通（256 / 512 / 3968 MB 都过），但它不在缓冲声明的可用类型位里（外部缓冲 0x13，同尺寸普通缓冲 0x41 含类型 6），属规范外用法；同机 A/B（同一份二进制，只改 DM_ZC_CACHED，固定 10 秒采 utime+stime）CPU 时间没有可测差异（同峰配对 <3%、轮间波动 ±100%）⇒ 收益看不到、风险不付，维持类型 4。换轨处显式优先取带 HOST_CACHED 的零拷贝类型、取不到或分配失败回退类型 4，开关 DM_ZC_CACHED 默认关（缺省行为与改动前一致），日志标出"越过缓冲声明的可用类型位"。坑点两条：DM_WATCH_STALL=0 不是"只记不杀"（crash.c:347-354 里值 ≤ 0 回落到 15 秒，写 0 等于停住 15 秒判死退出，dm.conf 里的注释原先写错）；MIUI 上 adb install -r 被拦（INSTALL_FAILED_USER_RESTRICTED），改用设备端 pm install -r 即可。  M3-2q: item 2 of section nine (preferring HOST_CACHED for the zero-copy type) is measured and **ruled out** -- the probe gained DM_FD_MEM_TYPE / DM_FD_FORCE / DM_FD_SIZE plus a "plain versus external buffer" type-bit readout: on type 6 the allocation, the fd, mmap at a chosen address and both directions all pass (256 / 512 / 3968 MB alike), but type 6 is not among the buffer's declared allowed types (an external buffer reports 0x13, while a plain buffer of the same size reaches 0x41 and does include type 6), which is outside the spec; the same-device A/B (one binary, only DM_ZC_CACHED changes, utime+stime sampled at a fixed 10 seconds) shows no measurable CPU-time difference (under 3% within the same mode against a +-100% run-to-run spread), so there is no gain to be had and no reason to pay the risk -- type 4 stays. The overlay path now prefers the zero-copy type with HOST_CACHED explicitly and falls back to type 4 when it is missing or the allocation fails, with DM_ZC_CACHED defaulting to off (default behaviour identical to before) and the log naming the "steps outside the buffer's declared allowed types" case. Two traps recorded: DM_WATCH_STALL=0 is not "log without killing" (in crash.c:347-354 a value <= 0 falls back to 15 seconds, so writing 0 means a 15-second stall is declared dead and exits -- the comment in dm.conf was wrong), and MIUI refuses adb install -r (INSTALL_FAILED_USER_RESTRICTED) while a device-side pm install -r works.
